steps.title: Take the question
steps.process: The economies, years and measures in the question are read using code, and the reading is shown so the user can correct it.

means.step: Choose the use mode and the reply length
Read the economies, years and measures in the question

at_full_scale.in_this_build: Each question answered on its own, with no memory of earlier questions.
at_full_scale.at_full_scale: Earlier questions in the conversation used in routing and in finding passages.

steps.title: Route
steps.process: The question is sent, using code, to the cheapest route that can answer it: a series title, a calculation, passages, or a person.

means.step: Ask the user to clarify a vague question
Escalate a question beyond the data

at_full_scale.at_full_scale: A governed bank of hundreds of test questions, run again after every change to the data or the code.

at_full_scale.in_this_build: Questions sorted into question types by keyword rules; a typed question read in parts, with each part open to correction by the user.
at_full_scale.at_full_scale: Questions sorted into question types by a small or fine-tuned language model, with routing accuracy measured all the time; the catalogue of measures kept by the vertical domain expert for each subject.

steps.title: Fetch evidence
steps.process: Passages the use mode does not allow are removed, the matching passages are found, and the figures are calculated from the data, all using code.

means.step: Keep only the passages the use mode allows
Find the passages that match the question

at_full_scale.at_full_scale: A catalogue of thousands of series, each with its definition, source and owner.

at_full_scale.in_this_build: Two editions of the data, stored in files.
at_full_scale.at_full_scale: A data warehouse with bitemporal tables: each value stored with the year it describes and the edition it came from.

at_full_scale.in_this_build: One method for calculating the figures (the NNI model).
at_full_scale.at_full_scale: A library of approved calculation methods, and a semantic layer: one shared set of definitions used by every query.
The full document estate: every report, manual and note held by the organisation.

at_full_scale.in_this_build: Hybrid search: keyword search and search by meaning, combined.
at_full_scale.at_full_scale: Hybrid search over a vector index, with reranking within a set time limit.

at_full_scale.in_this_build: A knowledge graph of 67 entities and 131 triples.
at_full_scale.at_full_scale: A graph database, in which each new triple is checked against rules on entry.

at_full_scale.in_this_build: Two use modes, non-commercial and commercial, chosen by the user.
at_full_scale.at_full_scale: Entitlements: access rights set by each customer's contract, checked at retrieval.

at_full_scale.in_this_build: The nearest measure to the one asked for, chosen in advance.
at_full_scale.at_full_scale: The nearest measure found by meaning, with how near it is stated in the reply.

at_full_scale.in_this_build: Two editions, each stored in full.
at_full_scale.at_full_scale: Every edition kept, storing only the values that changed, as in ALFRED and the UK Real-Time Data archive.

steps.title: Assemble context
steps.process: The template part is filled using code with figures, comparisons and definitions, and is put in the prompt with the chosen passages.

steps.title: Generate with citations
steps.process: The explanation is the language model's output: a few sentences, each ending with the id of the passage it cites.

means.step: Answer a definition question from passages

steps.title: Check, record, escalate
steps.process: Each sentence is checked using code; the explanation is retried once or dropped, every step is recorded, and questions beyond the data are passed to a person.

means.step: Check each sentence of the explanation
Retry once, or drop the explanation
Record each step in the trace

at_full_scale.in_this_build: Explanations checked by word overlap; an explanation that fails the checks is dropped.
at_full_scale.at_full_scale: The error rate of each check measured; every dropped explanation read by the vertical domain expert, who corrects it or records the fault.

at_full_scale.in_this_build: Tokens and seconds for each route, from saved runs.
at_full_scale.at_full_scale: A trace of every question, and a limit on tokens and time for each route.
